{{Quote|Alara!|A fellow Jedi upon witnessing Alara's death|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
'''Alara''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She was present at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Deceived" /> in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> when the Empire launched a [[Sacking of Coruscant|surprise attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] infiltrated and assaulted the Temple with a strike team of fifty other [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Alara joined her fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the defense of their home; she attacked Malgus alongside two of her comrades, but was quickly defeated&mdash;the Sith Lord [[Cho sun/Legends|severed]] Alara's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding [[Limb/Legends|hand]] and throttled her with his own hand before slamming her into the Temple floor with [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-enhanced strength, [[Death/Legends|killing]] her. Malgus's forces were victorious in the battle, slaughtering Alara's Jedi brethren before destroying the Temple as a whole in what would prove to be the final battle of the war.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alara first appeared in ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', a [[2011]] novel written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="Deceived" /> Prior to its release, an excerpt of the novel that included a mention of Alara was published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 16]]. [[2010]].<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/deceived_excerpt/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Old Republic: Deceived'' Excerpt}}</ref>
